API engineering for your agents. Go faster from development to production with higher accuracy and fewer tokens

Postman CLI v1.73.0
Get Postman plugins for your agents. Run `npx @postman/postman-plugin install`

USAGE
  postman <command> [subcommand] [flags]

CORE COMMANDS
  api:          Publish and test your APIs directly from the command line
  collection:   Run and test your Postman collections directly from the command line
  dataset:      Work with Postman datasets in local YAML files or the cloud
  environment:  Work with local and cloud Postman environments
  flows:        Manage and interact with flows
  globals:      Work with local and cloud Postman globals
  mock:         Create, run, and manage Postman mocks
  monitor:      Run and manage Postman monitors
  request:      Send HTTP requests with full Postman capabilities
  runner:       Start and inspect self-hosted runners, and list Postman-operated regions
  sdk:          Generate and manage your SDKs directly from the command line
  spec:         Lint and validate specifications from the command line
  workspace:    Manage workspace resources

AGENT COMMANDS
  context-graph:  Ask natural-language questions about your team's Context Graph
  describe:       Get API context for AI coding agents directly from the command line
  init:           Set up Postman artifacts and agent instructions in a repository
  search:         Search for Postman element types
  skills:         Check and update the agent skills in this repository

AUTHENTICATION COMMANDS
  login:   Authenticate with Postman to access your resources
  logout:  Delete the stored Postman API key
  signup:  Sign up to keep the work you created as a guest
  whoami:  Show the Postman account or guest session this CLI session is using

ADDITIONAL COMMANDS
  application:  Application-level commands: initialise config and run tests
  dependency:   Manage workspace dependencies reused from other workspaces
  feedback:     Submit feedback about CLI usability, gaps, and improvements
  performance:  Manage performance tests on your collections
  secret:       Create and manage Postman secrets in a team's shared vault
  simulation:   Create, run and manage simulations
  team:         Work with the teams inside your organisation
  update:       Update Postman CLI using the original installation method
  webhook:      Create and manage Postman webhooks

ALIAS COMMANDS
  app:  Alias for "application"
  fl:   Alias for "flows"
  ws:   Alias for "workspace"

FLAGS
  --color <value>  Enable/Disable colored output (auto|on|off)
  --help           Show help for command
  --silent         Silences all terminal output
  --version        Show postman version

EXAMPLES
  $ postman init
  $ postman request GET https://postman-echo.com/get
  $ postman collection run ./postman/collections/quickstart

LEARN MORE
  Use `postman <command> --help` for more information about a command.
  Read the documentation at https://learning.postman.com/docs/postman-cli/postman-cli-overview/
  View the command reference at https://learning.postman.com/docs/postman-cli/postman-cli-options/
  Read release notes at https://www.postman.com/release-notes/postman-cli/
  Coming from Newman? See https://learning.postman.com/docs/reference/newman-cli/migrate-to-postman-cli/
  Get support at https://support.postman.com/ or file issues at https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues
